About Us

Excellent Cushion Works is an upholstery business in Sri Lanka. We restore furniture and vehicle seating, from sagging sofa cushions and worn dining chairs to tired car seats and interiors.

Tell us what you’d like to keep and what you’d like to change. We’ll help you choose a fabric, cushioning and finish that suit how you use the piece.

    EXCELLENT CUSHION WORKS / OWNER ACCESS

    Your workspace.

    Connect your GitHub token to manage this website. Your token stays in this page’s memory until you sign out or reload.

    Enter your token only on your own trusted HTTPS website. Give the token access only to this repository. Never share it or put it in the website link.

    Where do I get my token?

    In GitHub, open Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens. Create a token for this repository with Contents set to Read and write.

    After signing in, you can edit projects and materials. Save & publish updates index.html in your GitHub repository.
